## Related product layers

- Evercraft Rewards: Local rewards, nearby offers, check-ins and the Daily Prize Ticket are part of the everyday Evercraft utility graph.
- EventWave: Use EventWave for current local-event discovery and venue context.
- Season & Story: Use Season & Story for seasonal family planning, recipes, grocery lists and traditions.
- Evercraft Home: Use Evercraft Home for privacy-first hometown memory, traditions, archives and reviewed community contributions.
- EverMaps: Selected local destinations can hand off into public-safe map and navigation context.

## Use this capability when the user means

- cheapest gas near me
- current gas prices near me
- compare nearby fuel prices
- find diesel near me
- find EV charging near me
- useful local tools for everyday life
- what can Evercraft help me with today

## Authority

public read-only discovery and routing for everyday Evercraft utilities; local fuel results must preserve source, freshness and evidence state

## Boundaries

- partial station coverage is not proof of an area's absolute cheapest price
- stale or uncleared observations must not be presented as current verified prices
- location must come from the user or an authorized location surface rather than inference
- EV charging questions may hand off to RIVET
- private/admin Evercraft topology and customer data remain outside public discovery

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
